text:
maya r: heads-up — noticed sampled inspect logs contain unredacted emails when requests fall back to legacy-proxy :grimacing:

jordan p: omg, repro steps? is this only for fallback routes or all routes? :eyes:

maya r: only on fallback. sequence: primary router rejects due to capacity -> fallback to legacy-proxy -> sampler runs upstream and sees raw body. legacy-proxy doesn't re-run scrubber.

alex k: quick mitigation: flip fallback to mark requests with header `x-redact-status: pending` and ensure legacy-proxy runs scrubber when that header present. low risk, quick deploy.

samira: we should also flip default sampling for fallback to 0% until scrub is enforced. can't have PII leaking in audit logs.

maya r: agreed. also want a console flag to block inspect capture for fallbacks (prod-safe toggle).

jordan p: can you paste one of the logs (sanitized) so infra can verify the path?

maya r: pasted snippet (sanitized):

```
REQUEST id=abc123 route=fallback legacy-proxy=true body="{\"user_email\": \"alice@example.com\", \"prompt\": \"...\" }" sampler=enabled
```

alex k: thanks. immediate steps I propose:
- set fallback sampling to 0%
- add `x-redact-status: pending` header at router
- legacy-proxy: run scrubber if header present
- console: surface fallback-sample-rate metric + PII-detection ratio

samira: UX note: console toggle should be two-step (disable capture -> confirm -> audit entry). We need audit trail if someone enables inspect for fallback routes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered canary for legacy-proxy scrubber patch (sha: d4c7a2) :rocket:

sre-bot: canary started at 1765654400, 10% traffic. observing for errors.

jordan p: telemetry asks: how will we measure "PII leakage"? we need simple metric e.g., detected_email_count / sampled_messages.

maya r: exactly. add a daily alert if ratio > 0.001 for any tenant.

alex k: long-term fix: move sampler to run after routing decisions and after any proxy transform. sampler should be final gate before logs hit S3/inspect. config sketch:

```
sampler:
  run_at: post_routing
  rules:
    - name: fallback_block
      if: request.meta.route_fallback == true
      action: force_sample: 0
    - name: pii_guard
      detect: [email, ssn]
      action: redact_and_drop_if_sensitive: true
```

samira: also require that any rollout of a routing change includes an "inspect impact" check in the rollout checklist. small checkbox in console for canaries.

maya r: agree. owner: alex k for immediate mitigation, samira for console toggle/UX, jordan p for telemetry alert. I'll open follow-up issues.

ops-bot: mitigation patch promoted to 50% at 1765654510.

sre-bot: canary looks stable. no error increase. monitoring: scrubbed_count=1245, unredacted_detects=0 (so far).

alex k: once prod vetting done we'll flip fallback sampling back to configured value, but default remains 0 until post-routing sampler is live.

maya r: thanks all — gonna update incident doc and link to the dashboard once available. :thumbsup:
